applies_to: AAON packaged units run by the Auto-Zone 3 controller, alone or with AZ 3 VAV/zone dampers.
summary: The Auto-Zone 3 (AZ 3) controller runs an AAON packaged unit, either alone or as the air source for an AZ 3 zoning system. It has an on-board BACnet MS/TP port. The object map has 35 read-only analog inputs, 69 writable analog values (setpoints, offsets, overrides and BAS-supplied sensor values) and 59 read-only binary inputs (enable status, alarms and relay status).
notes: AI and BI objects are read-only; AV objects are read/write. Sensor inputs cannot be written directly; the BAS writes AV 66-69 instead.
A setpoint written over BACnet is held in temporary memory until midnight, then saved as the new default; a power cycle before midnight loses it.
AI 2-4 and AI 31 are coded values; the bit meanings are in the guide's tables on pages 95-96.
Analog value units are not printed for most points; ranges are shown as printed.
Source: Appendix C AZ 3 BACnet Parameters, guide pages 88-94.

integration.summary: Connect the on-board MS/TP port and set address, device ID and baud. The BAS schedules the unit with AV 62 Schedule Force, adjusts the occupied heating and cooling setpoints, and can override HVAC mode, fan VFD and OA damper or supply space and outdoor values through AV 66-69. Read the alarm status AI and the alarm BIs.

minimum_points.name: Occupied Cooling Setpoint
minimum_points.why: Cooling starts one degree above this

minimum_points.name: Occupied Heating Setpoint
minimum_points.why: Heating starts one degree below this

integration.enable: AV 62 Schedule Force sets occupancy (0 = controller schedule, 1 = forced occupied, 2 = forced unoccupied). AV 63 overrides the HVAC mode and AV 64 and AV 65 override fan VFD and OA damper; writing Auto (0, or 65535 for the VFD and damper) hands control back.
integration.remote_sensors: Sensor inputs cannot be written; the BAS writes AV 66 BACnet Space Temperature, AV 67 BACnet Space Humidity, AV 68 BACnet Outdoor Air Temperature and AV 69 BACnet Outdoor Air Humidity.
setup: MAC address (0-254, default 0), device ID (up to seven digits) and MS/TP baud rate (9600-76800, default 38400) are set on the controller's LCD Settings screens.
gotchas: Setpoints written over BACnet become permanent only at midnight; a power cycle before then loses them.
